articles.title: Quote of the day by David Hume: 'Nothing is more surprising than the easiness with which the many are governed by the few...' - Why people accept authority of others on them explained by Scottish philosopher
articles.description: David Hume’s famous quote, “Nothing is more surprising than the easiness with which the many are governed by the few,” explores why a small group of people can hold power over millions. articles.title: Optical illusion personality test: What you see first reveals if you talk too much, interrupt, or trust strangers too easily
articles.description: Optical illusion personality tests are interesting brain teasers that trick the brain and eyes into believing what they see first, based on their perspective, focus, and thoughts running through their head at the time. The most interesting part of these images is that one person spots a face, another sees a train, and both are sure they are right. That small difference is what makes optical illusions so much fun, and they claim to reveal hidden traits about your personality based on what you see first. It is quite easy and does not require much effort; users are required to look at a busy image full of hidden shapes, notice what they see first, then read what that supposedly says about you. This personality test also has many interesting images hidden in itself and, each first glance points to a different, slightly strange side of your character. But before you dive into the answers, take the test yourself first. Here, this is the image. So, what did you see first?

articles.title: The tech behind a Dolby cinema | TechPulse
articles.description: Dolby has opened its fifth Dolby Cinema in India, this time in Kochi, Kerala, against its earlier announcement of six locations. We travelled to Kochi to check out the theatre and understand what actually separates a Dolby Cinema from a regular Dolby-equipped theatre. One of the biggest differences is the projection system, which is exclusive to Dolby Cinema and claims a contrast ratio of 1,000,000:1. The system also allows operators to configure presets and schedule projection settings. In this video, we take a closer look at the projection setup, how it works and what makes it different from the systems used in other theatres.#DolbyCinema #Kochi #Kerala #CinemaTechnology #ProjectionSystem
